page.notes: Doubtful readings: "autea" (as printed, probably for "antea"); "Cerintbus" (printed with b, probably for Cerinthus); "sectaror" (as printed, probably for "sectatorem"/"sectator"). The mark after "Epiphanio" at the line end is a small reference-like sign I could not identify; it is not transcribed. A small mark stands before "Si" at the start of the last line, also not transcribed. Spelling of i/j and u/v adjusted as instructed. Long s rendered as s. The "Digitized by Google" stamp at the bottom right is excluded.
